name: Feint Expert (Ex)
body:
Benefit: Once per day, a rogue with this talent may reroll a Feint check. She must decide to reroll this check after rolling the die, but before the results are revealed. The rogue must take the second result, even if it is worse.

Special: A rogue can use this ability one additional time per day for every 5 rogue levels she possesses.
